title: Spectral Rank Under Sum vs Mean Aggregation: Validating the Information-Compression Mechanism at FK Joins
summary: Demo notebook showing spectral rank analysis comparing SUM vs MEAN aggregation on 3 RelBench tasks. Loads pre-computed experiment results (mini_demo_data.json with 21 edge-type measurements across 7 dataset splits). Demonstrates SVD effective rank computation, variance-entropy proxy, and compression ratio functions on synthetic data, then parses and visualizes the cross-aggregation comparison results with bar charts showing rank ratios, compression differences, and fraction of edges where sum outperforms mean.
